issues.where: the storm through the whole liquid volume, especially the left side and lower front
issues.what: The candidate reads as a tight circular vortex made of broad continuous white ribbons. The target mixes finer broken streaks and individually lit flecks at several depths, with a softer snow cloud near the floor. The intended extra occlusion is not the problem.
issues.fix: Keep the extra coverage, but break up the long bands, vary streak length and focus by depth, and diffuse the low snow into a layered cloud with warm glints.

issues.where: the tabletop immediately under and in front of the base, also in set B
issues.what: The dark tabletop loses the readable mirror image of the gold foot, warm pinpoint highlights and cool bright right rim. Broad flat white skid-like marks and a heavy contact band replace the target's scattered, raised frost and snow.
issues.fix: Restore a tight contact shadow and a coherent, mildly blurred mirror image beneath the foot, including the cool right arc and warm glints. Break the white streaks into granular snow and distinct feathery crystals with dark gaps.

issues.where: glass shoulder, top dimple and right highlight, also in set B
issues.what: The top oval is bigger and reads as an outlined bubble cap; the right-hand white reflection is rounder and more blurred and the shell edge reads like a comparatively thin blue outline. The frost is coarser and more regularly combed along the left edge, with some separate stenciled tufts near the floor, instead of dissolving into the thickness of the glass.
issues.fix: Reduce the top oval, sharpen and elongate the white shoulder reflection, bring back the doubled refractive edge and blend finer uneven feather clusters into the shell.

issues.what: The cottage is bulkier, the roof rises higher and has a thick smooth overhang on the right, and the wall is made of chunkier high-contrast cobbles. The target's neatly framed arched door, distinct stepped threshold and delicate fence give way to a less legible door surround and heavier rails and posts.
issues.fix: Lower and refine the roof and fascia, use smaller textured masonry, restore the deep arch with vertical wood boards and visible steps, and slim the fence to match the target.

issues.where: tree crown, branch network and trunk
issues.what: The target has finely layered snow-covered boughs, a wide twisted bark trunk and small embedded lights. The candidate has clumpier isolated snow caps, cleaner glossy orange branches and prominent clusters of uniformly bright bulbs.
issues.fix: Shape the snow to more continuous layered boughs, roughen and thicken the organic trunk, and make the bulbs smaller and less uniformly bright, with light spilling naturally onto nearby branches.

issues.what: The pond reads wider and flatter gray, with a blunt dark edge and a broad blurry gold pool. The target has irregular snowy banks, a more textured blue surface and a compact sparkling lamp reflection.
issues.fix: Recover the irregular bank and blue ice texture, tighten the golden reflection and reduce the lamppost halo so the fixture remains distinct.

issues.what: An oversized yellow bloom from the lamp floods the cottage front and door; the target shows a defined lantern, a restrained pool low in the snow, and crisp warm lights along the gable where it shows through. This is light spill rather than the intended storm occlusion.
issues.fix: Keep the extra snow cover, but tighten the lamp bloom, recover the lantern silhouette and separate the warm gable bulbs from the lit haze.

issues.where: collar, snow cap and icicles, also in set B
issues.what: The exposed seat and lip read as two clean gold stripes, and the snow looks flatter and more crusted. The icicles are mostly thin uniform needles with less interior sparkle than the target's thicker irregular glassy drops.
issues.fix: Seat the globe with a thinner, partly buried collar and dark seam, make the snow more irregular and granular, and vary icicle thickness and warm/cold refraction.

issues.where: wood-and-metal base from frieze to foot, also in set B
issues.what: The leaf-and-cone relief is thinner, darker and more sharply outlined, the right wood panel is washed with a flat pale frosting, and the foot reads as cleaner more separated bands. The target has fuller polished leaf relief, more visible wood and softer bronze highlights.
issues.fix: Restore relief depth, warmer aged bronze and dark visible wood on the right, with less uniform trim shine and more rounded rope molding.

issues.where: out-of-focus lights behind the globe, also in set B
issues.what: The blue blobs are more uniform and pronounced and the far upper-right warm halo is weaker, making the light behind the object a little flatter.
issues.fix: Match the target's less regular cool bokeh shapes and restore the subdued warm halo without changing the smooth background.
